newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara denies stopping swap transactions.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara denies stopping swap transactions.

text.p: The Malaysian central bank denied on Friday that it has told banks to stop undertaking swap transactions.
"Bank Negara Malaysia has denied...that it has issued instructions to banks to stop undertaking swap transactions," the central bank said in a statement.
The market was on Friday awashed with rumours that the central bank has stopped ringgit swap facilities for foreign banks, after the ringgit was roiled in recent days against the major currencies.
"The shortage in ringgit in the market arising from the speculative activities has resulted in a rise in the short-term money market rates.
"This is a temporary phenomena. "The currrent monetary policy stance remains unchanged," the four-sentence statement said.
